name_reason: Follows the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention exactly: domain=battle (pathfind is a battle subsystem; confirmed by the prior Ghidra PRE trailer 'subsystem = battle' and the battle-only callers), descriptor 'pathfind_current_depth' accurately reflects a recursion-depth counter byte. No Ghidra address residue in the name. Datatype (counter byte) is implied by 'depth/count' semantics. Keep.
purpose: Current recursion depth of the directional pathfind DFS; doubles as the candidate step count compared against best_path_length when the destination is reached.
logic_summary: Single unsigned byte at 0x60077 (.object3). fd2_pathfind_to_destination zero-inits it on entry (MOV [0x60077],0 at 0x4E25A, paired with best_path_length=0xFF). fd2_pathfind_recursive_with_direction INCs it on descend (0x4E28B) and DECs it on backtrack (0x4E329), so it tracks the live DFS branch depth. Read as the loop length when walking the step stack in fd2_pathfind_count_unique_directions (0x4E3D4), and as the arrival depth in fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path (0x4E411) where it is unsigned-compared against best_path_length (CMP AH,[0x60078]; JA) and, on a win, stored back as the new best (MOV [0x60078],AH).
element_semantics: Scalar recursion-depth / step counter. Range 0..max_steps during a search; sits as a standalone byte between data_fd2_battle_pathfind_path_output_buffer_ptr (0x60073, 4-byte pointer) and data_fd2_battle_pathfind_best_path_length (0x60078). Not an array.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (pathfnd.c lines 931-947) is already precise, accurate, ASCII-clean, and matches all disassembly evidence (INC 0x4E28B, DEC 0x4E329, init 0x4E25A, reads 0x4E3D4/0x4E411). No issue; kept verbatim.
